flat_rate_pct.unit: % flat, all filers (long-term capital gains taxed at the same 5% rate; short-term at 8.5%, not modeled since this app only models long-term gains)

surtax.unit: extra % on taxable income above threshold, same threshold for all filing statuses
surtax.note: 'Fair Share' / Millionaires Surtax; inflation-indexed threshold ($1,000,000 in 2023, $1,107,750 for 2026). Combined top rate: 9% ordinary/LTCG, 12.5% STCG above threshold.

personal_exemption_single.note: MA has not historically inflation-indexed these amounts; 2025 figure treated as current for 2026.

senior_addl_exemption_per_person.note: No separate MA income-tax deduction/exemption tied purely to age 65+ beyond the personal exemptions above; MA's senior benefit runs through the Circuit Breaker property-tax credit instead (see senior_tax_credits).

social_security.note: SS benefits are excluded from MA gross income entirely.

retirement_income.note: Private pensions, 401(k)/403(b), and traditional IRA distributions are fully taxable at 5% (9% above the surtax threshold). MA and other US-government pensions (and military pensions) are fully exempt -- not modeled here since this app's IRA/401(k) income represents private-style retirement accounts, not a government pension.

senior_tax_credits.note: Senior Circuit Breaker Tax Credit is MA's main senior break -- see property_tax below. No separate income-tax-only senior credit exists.

effective_rate_pct.unit: % of home value/year, statewide avg effective rate

property_tax.relief_programs_note: Senior Circuit Breaker Tax Credit: age 65+ by Dec 31, own or rent MA residential property as primary residence, 2025 income limits Single $75,000/HOH $94,000/MFJ $112,000. Refundable credit if property tax (plus half of water/sewer) exceeds 10% of total MA income (homeowners) or 25% of annual rent exceeds 10% of income (renters); maximum credit $2,820 (2025). Income-tested -- not applied to the estimate below since it depends on income limits not modeled here, but worth checking manually if your MA income is near these thresholds.
